comment.body: Engineering should investigate metrics ingestion and dashboard rendering regressions after the recent upgrade for observability beta customers. Confirm if metric pipelines are active and check for configuration changes made post-upgrade.

Thank you for reporting this issue. Our engineering team is actively investigating the missing metrics since your recent upgrade for the observability beta. We appreciate your patience and will provide updates as soon as we have more information.

reply:
I triaged the inbox according to the team plan:

- For the observability-beta incident ("dashboards show no metrics since upgrade"), I:
  1. Kept the ticket open.
  2. Set the priority to urgent.
  3. Added the "obs-beta" tag (preserving existing tags).
  4. Left a private investigation note for engineering on metrics ingestion and dashboard regressions.
  5. Posted a public acknowledgment letting the customer know the issue is being investigated.

No other open tickets matched the observability-beta criteria. All policy requirements and protections were followed, and other tickets were unchanged. Work on this triage assignment is complete.
